name: Vividora
tagline: Record once. Vividora edits, captions and publishes your videos.
summary: An AI video studio for creators and businesses who record their own videos. Upload a recording and Vividora cleans the voice, writes a Hindi or English transcript, cuts silences, fillers and retakes, adds stylish captions and renders versions for YouTube, Shorts, Instagram Reels and Facebook Reels. Nothing is published until you approve it.
features:
Cleans the voice and removes silences, fillers and retakes
Hindi and English captions with word-level timing
One recording becomes YouTube, Shorts, Reels and Facebook versions
Approve each video on WhatsApp before it goes live
Scheduled publishing to YouTube, Instagram and Facebook
Runs on your own computer or server: your footage stays with you
whoFor:
YouTubers and creators
Coaches and teachers
Doctors, CAs and consultants
Shops and local brands
Marketing agencies
plans:
Self-hosted | 0 | free | Install it yourself on your PC or server. All studio features, no subscription
Studio setup | 9999 | one-time | We install Vividora on your PC or VPS, connect YouTube, Instagram and WhatsApp approvals, and support you for 30 days | popular
Managed studio | On request | monthly | We run Vividora for you on our servers. Join the waitlist
priceNote: Prices in Indian rupees. GST is shown at checkout and on your invoice. A Windows PC with an NVIDIA graphics card is recommended for fast transcription.
slideTitle: Record once. Get edited, captioned videos for every platform.
slideText: Vividora cuts the retakes, adds Hindi or English captions and publishes to YouTube and Reels after you approve on WhatsApp.
faqs:
Do I need a subscription?|No. The self-hosted studio is free. You pay once if you want us to install and set it up for you.
Where are my videos stored?|On your own computer or server. Your footage is not uploaded to us unless you choose to publish it or share it with us for support.
Does it publish without asking me?|Never. Every video waits for your approval in the dashboard or on WhatsApp.
What computer do I need?|Any recent PC works; a Windows PC with an NVIDIA graphics card makes transcription much faster. We check your system before taking payment for a setup.
legalTerms: Vividora is video editing software. Studio setup is a one-time service in which we install and configure Vividora on a computer or server you own or rent; the managed studio is a monthly service we run for you. You keep all rights to your recordings and finished videos, and you are responsible for having the rights to any music, footage or people that appear in them and for following the rules of YouTube, Meta (Instagram and Facebook) and any other platform you publish to. AI-generated transcripts, captions, titles and scripts can contain mistakes: review every video before you approve it. We are not responsible for actions a platform takes on your channel or account.
legalPrivacy: When you use the self-hosted studio or a Studio setup, your recordings, transcripts and finished videos are stored on your own computer or server, not with us. During installation and support we may connect to your machine with your permission; we only access what is needed to set up and fix the studio. Optional AI features send text such as transcripts and titles, not your video, to the AI provider you choose (for example Google Gemini), using your own API key. Logins for YouTube, Instagram and Facebook are stored encrypted on your installation and are used only to publish what you approve. Vividora does not use advertising trackers. For the managed studio, your files are stored on our servers only for as long as your plan is active, and are deleted within 30 days after it ends.
legalRefunds: Studio setup: if we cannot complete the installation on your hardware, we refund the full amount. Once the studio is installed and working, the setup fee is not refundable, but the 30 days of support are included. Managed studio: you can cancel at any time and the plan runs until the end of the paid period; if you cancel within 7 days of your first payment, we refund it in full.
legalDelivery: Studio setup is delivered online: we schedule a remote session within 2 working days of payment and usually finish the installation within 3 to 7 working days, depending on your hardware and platform approvals. You receive your login details and a short handover by WhatsApp or email. The managed studio is activated within 1 working day of payment.

name: BizCRT
tagline: Every conversation counts. Business · Connect · Remind · Track.
summary: One app for your whole business on the official WhatsApp Business Platform: team inbox, leads and follow-ups, renewals and reminders, staff, chatbots, broadcast campaigns, GST billing, appointments and a business page.
features:
Official WhatsApp Cloud API team inbox
Leads, follow-ups and renewal reminders
Chatbots, flows and broadcast campaigns
GST bills, quotations and payment links
Appointments, forms and a business page
Reseller and white-label programme
whoFor:
Shops and showrooms
Clinics and salons
Schools and coaching
Real estate
Agencies and resellers
priceNote: Free plan to start. Live plans and prices are shown on the BizCRT page.
slideTitle: Your whole business on WhatsApp, in one app.
slideText: BizCRT brings the official WhatsApp inbox, leads, reminders, billing and campaigns together. Start on the free plan.
legalTerms: BizCRT connects to the official WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API) and other platforms using your own accounts. WhatsApp and Meta message charges are billed by Meta directly to you; we do not sell message credits and are not responsible for Meta's pricing, template reviews, quality ratings or account restrictions. AI features use your own AI provider key. Payments you collect from your customers through BizCRT go to your own payment gateway account, and you are responsible for your products, refunds and disputes with your customers. You must follow the WhatsApp Business Messaging and Commerce policies and message only people who have agreed to hear from you. The full BizCRT terms at bizcrt.com/legal/terms also apply.
legalPrivacy: For BizCRT account holders (business owners and their team), we decide how account data is used. For a business's own customers and contacts, the business decides and we process that data only to provide BizCRT to that business. BizCRT stores account data (name, email, role), business data (page content, products, invoices, plan and payment records), connected-account identifiers and access tokens (stored in restricted tables that cannot be read from the browser), and the contacts, messages, leads, appointments and form answers the business handles. Business page analytics are counts only and are not linked to a visitor's identity. The full BizCRT privacy policy at bizcrt.com/legal/privacy also applies.
legalRefunds: The free plan and any free trial cost nothing, so please try BizCRT before you pay. A duplicate or failed payment is refunded in full. A new paid plan can be refunded within the refund window stated on bizcrt.com/legal/refund. Renewals, unused time when switching plans, Meta or AI provider charges, and accounts closed for breaking WhatsApp or our rules are not refunded. BizCRT plans never renew automatically, so cancelling simply means not renewing; your plan stays active until the end of the paid period.
legalDelivery: BizCRT is delivered online and nothing is shipped. A plan paid online is active as soon as the payment is confirmed, usually within minutes. A UPI transfer with a reference number is activated after we verify it, usually the same working day. If you are charged but the plan is not active within 24 hours, contact us with the payment reference and we will activate it or refund you.

name: Vivid Relay
tagline: Send campaigns, auto-replies and app alerts from your own WhatsApp number.
summary: A lightweight WhatsApp messaging gateway you link to your own number. Send campaigns at a safe pace, post to groups, channels and Status, run auto-replies and AI answers, and connect any app (your website, BizCRT, n8n) through a simple API and webhooks. Use it as a hosted service or install it on your own server with a licence key.
features:
Campaigns at a human pace, with number warm-up and daily limits
Groups, communities, channels and Status posts on a schedule
Auto-replies, AI answers and chatbot flows
REST API and webhooks for your website and apps
Rotate up to 10 numbers on one account
Hosted, or self-hosted on your own server with a licence key
whoFor:
Shops and service businesses
Coaching and schools
Developers and agencies
App makers who need WhatsApp alerts
plans:
Free trial | 0 | 7 days | 1 number, 100 messages a day, 1,000 in total
Starter | 499 | per 30 days | 1 number, 250 messages a day, 7,500 a month, 5,000 contacts
Growth | 1299 | per 30 days | 3 numbers with rotation, 30,000 messages a month, 25,000 contacts | popular
Business | 2999 | per 30 days | 10 numbers, 1,00,000 messages a month, 1,00,000 contacts
priceNote: Prices in Indian rupees. GST is shown at checkout and on your invoice. Plans are prepaid for 30 days; renew when you want to continue.
slideTitle: WhatsApp campaigns and app alerts from your own number.
slideText: Vivid Relay sends at a safe pace, auto-replies for you and connects your website and apps through a simple API.
faqs:
Is this the official WhatsApp Business API?|No. Vivid Relay links to your number the way WhatsApp Web does. For the official Cloud API with green-tick eligibility, use BizCRT.
Can my number get blocked?|Any number that sends unwanted messages can be restricted by WhatsApp. Relay slows down, warms up new numbers and stops on warning signs, but you must message only people who agreed to hear from you.
Do you store my chats?|No. Relay does not save chat history or incoming photos and files. It keeps the contacts and campaign logs you create.
Can I install it on my own server?|Yes. Self-hosted installs run with a licence key on your own VPS or office server.
legalTerms: Vivid Relay is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to WhatsApp or Meta. It links to your WhatsApp number the same way WhatsApp Web does, and is not the official WhatsApp Business Platform. WhatsApp may limit, suspend or ban any number, and we cannot prevent or reverse that. You must use Relay only to message people who have agreed to hear from you, must honour STOP and opt-out requests, and must not send spam, illegal, misleading or abusive content. We may suspend an account that is used for spam or that harms our service. Licence keys for self-hosted installs are for the number of numbers and the period you paid for, and may not be resold or shared.
legalPrivacy: Relay stores your account details, the contacts and lists you upload or create, message templates, scheduled campaigns and delivery logs (number, status and time). It does not save chat history, incoming photos or files. The link to your WhatsApp number is stored encrypted and you can unlink it at any time from Relay or from your phone. Contacts you upload belong to you: we process them only to send the messages you schedule, and you are responsible for having their consent. Self-hosted installs keep all of this on your own server; the licence check sends only the licence key and an install identifier to us.
legalRefunds: Use the free trial to check that Relay works with your number before you pay. If a paid plan cannot be connected to your number because of a fault on our side that we cannot fix, we refund it in full within 7 days of payment. A duplicate or failed payment is refunded in full. We do not refund unused days or messages, renewals after use, or plans where the number was restricted or banned by WhatsApp, because that is outside our control.
legalDelivery: Relay is delivered online. A hosted plan is active as soon as the payment is confirmed, and you link your number by scanning a QR code. A self-hosted licence key is sent by email or WhatsApp within 2 working hours of payment; if we install it on your server for you, installation is usually completed within 2 working days.

name: Drishti
tagline: See how your offices are working, and help any PC remotely, from one screen.
summary: A staff activity and remote access platform for businesses with one or more offices. A small agent on each office computer shares which app is in use, active and idle time and periodic screenshots with a dashboard on your own server. Daily productivity scores and a leaderboard show who needs help, and one click opens a remote session to fix a PC. Everything runs on your own server, so your data never leaves your office.
features:
Live view of every office computer: online, idle or offline
Apps and websites in use, with productive and unproductive time
Screenshot timeline at the interval you choose
Daily productivity score, punctuality and leaderboard
Remote access to any office PC from the dashboard
Runs on your own server, across several offices and cities
whoFor:
Offices with several branches
BPOs and back offices
Accounts and data entry teams
IT support teams
plans:
Office setup | On request | one-time | We install the server, the agent on each PC and remote access, and train your managers
Per computer | On request | per month | Licence for each monitored computer, with updates and support
priceNote: Drishti is in early access. Tell us how many offices and computers you have and we will send a quotation.
slideTitle: Every office computer, on one screen.
slideText: Drishti shows active and idle time, apps in use and daily scores, and opens a remote session when a PC needs help.
faqs:
Does it record what staff type?|No. Drishti counts keystrokes and clicks to measure activity; it does not record the text that is typed.
Where is the data stored?|On your own server in your office or on your own cloud account. It is not sent to us.
Do staff need to be told?|Yes. Drishti is for computers your business owns, and your staff must be told in writing what is monitored and why before you switch it on.
Which computers does it support?|Windows office computers today. Remote access works for Windows, macOS and Linux.
legalTerms: Drishti may be installed only on computers and devices owned or controlled by your business, and used only for legitimate work purposes such as productivity, security and IT support. Before you switch it on, you must tell the people who use those computers, in writing, what Drishti collects, why, and how long you keep it, and obtain their consent where the law requires it. You must not use Drishti on personal devices, to monitor anyone covertly, or to collect passwords, private messages or sensitive personal data. Remote access must be used only with the user's knowledge. You are responsible for complying with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, the Information Technology Act, 2000 and any employment law that applies to you.
legalPrivacy: For Drishti, your business is the data fiduciary for the information collected about your staff, and we act only as your software and support provider. The Drishti agent collects: periodic screenshots of the main screen, the name of the app and window in use, active and idle time, the number of keystrokes and mouse clicks (never the text typed), the computer name and the agent version. This data is stored on your own server and is not sent to us. During installation and support we may access your server or computers with your permission, only to set up and fix Drishti. You decide how long data is kept and can delete it at any time; staff should send requests about their data to your business.
legalRefunds: If we cannot install Drishti on your server and office computers, we refund the office setup fee in full. Once setup is complete, the setup fee is not refundable. Monthly licence fees are not refunded for a period that has started, but you can stop renewing at any time, and a duplicate or failed payment is refunded in full.
legalDelivery: Drishti is delivered online or by a visit to your office where agreed. After payment and access to your server, we usually complete the installation within 7 working days, depending on the number of offices and computers. Licences are activated as soon as the installation is handed over.
